'''Zee Studios''' is an [[Cinema of India|Indian film]] [[production company|production]] and [[Film distributor|distribution]] company, that specializes in film, streaming, and television, content development and production. It also specializes in film marketing and distribution.<ref>{{cite news |title=Zee Entertainment Enterprises Ltd. |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/zee-entertainmen-3126/information/company-history |access-date=11 February 2023 |work=[[Business Standard India]]}}</ref> It is based in [[Mumbai]], [[India]], and it was established in 2012 as the content engine for [[Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Jha |first1=Lata |title=Zee Studios targets up to 40 movie releases per year |url=https://www.livemint.com/industry/media/zee-studios-targets-up-to-40-movie-releases-per-year-11674056066476.html |access-date=11 February 2023 |work=[[Livemint]] |date=18 January 2023 |language=en}}</ref>

==History==

Zee Studios was founded in 2012 and was formerly known as '''[[Essel Vision Productions]]'''. Before the establishment of Zee Studios, films were produced under the name Zee Telefilms. ''[[Gadar: Ek Prem Katha]]'', released in 2001, directed by [[Anil Sharma (director)|Anil Sharma]] and starring [[Sunny Deol]] and [[Ameesha Patel]], was one of the first films produced by Zee Telefilms. The film was declared an All-Time Blockbuster by [[Box Office India]] and ranked among the top 3 Indian films in all-time highest footfalls since the 1990s.<ref>{{cite news |title=Gadar - Ek Prem Katha {{!}} WorldWide Box Office Collections, Budget, etc |url=https://bestoftheyear.in/movie/gadar-ek-prem-katha/ |access-date=15 April 2023 |work=BOTY |archive-date=15 April 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230415060747/https://bestoftheyear.in/movie/gadar-ek-prem-katha/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>

===2015–2020===

The first-ever film produced under the banner of Zee Studios was [[Sanjay Gupta (director)|Sanjay Gupta]]’s thriller suspense ''[[Jazbaa]]'' in the year 2015, which starred [[Aishwarya Rai Bachchan]] alongside [[Irrfan Khan]] and [[Shabana Azmi]]. For her performance in the film, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan won the Stardust Award for Power-Packed Performance of the Year (2015).<ref>{{cite news |title=Jazbaa trailer revealed: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, Irrfan Khan starrer is edgy |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/bollywood/watch-aishwarya-rai-bachchan-returns-as-advocate-and-hysterical-mother-in-jazbaa/ |access-date=15 April 2023 |work=[[The Indian Express]] |date=25 August 2015 |language=en}}</ref>

In the same year (2015), Zee Studios forayed into regional cinema with a Marathi film, [[Katyar Kaljat Ghusali (film)|''Katyar Kaljat Ghusali'']], an epic musical drama. It starred [[Shankar Mahadevan]], [[Sachin Pilgaonkar (actor)|Sachin Pilgaonkar]], [[Subodh Bhave]], [[Pushkar Shrotri]], [[Mrunmayee Deshpande]] and [[Amruta Khanvilkar]] in the lead roles.<ref>{{cite news |title=Katyar Kaljat Ghusli movie review: Subodh Bhave, Sachin Pilgaonkar and Shankar Mahadevan give an unforgettable Diwali treat to music lovers! |url=https://www.bollywoodlife.com/news-gossip/katyar-kaljat-ghusli-movie-review-subodh-bhave-sachin-pilgaonkar-and-shankar-mahadevan-give-an-unforgettable-diwali-treat-to-music-lovers-625263/ |access-date=17 April 2023 |work=Bollywood Life |date=12 November 2015 |language=en}}</ref> The film marked the directorial debut of Subodh Bhave, the theatrical acting debut of Shankar Mahadevan, and [[Sakshi Tanwar]]'s [[Marathi cinema|Marathi film]] debut. The critics regarded the film as a rich treasure of music and was also a huge success at the box office. The film won the National Award for Best Male Playback Singer ([[Mahesh Kale]]). ''Katyar Kaljat Ghusali'' was selected to be screened at the 46th [[International Film Festival of India]] in [[Goa]]<ref>{{cite press release|url=http://www.iffi.nic.in/writereaddata/IP_2015_PressRelease_Selections.pdf|title=Indian Panorama selection of Feature & Non-Feature Films for 46th International Film Festival of India, 2015|accessdate=11 November 2015|publisher=International Film Festival of India|page=2|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151106055639/http://www.iffi.nic.in/writereaddata/IP_2015_PressRelease_Selections.pdf|archive-date=6 November 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref> and was considered for the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation ([[UNESCO]]) Fellini medal that year.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/pune/Marathi-film-Katyar-Kaljat-Ghusli-in-race-for-Unescos-Fellini-medal/articleshow/49837841.cms |title=Marathi film 'Katyar Kaljat Ghusli' in race for Unesco's Fellini medal |newspaper=The Times of India |date=19 November 2015 |accessdate=16 December 2015}}</ref>

In 2016 the company produced [[Natsamrat]] starring [[Nana Patekar]] and [[Medha Manjrekar]], which portrayed a tragic story of a stage actor.<ref>{{cite news |title=Natsamrat Movie Review |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/marathi/movie-reviews/natsamrat/movie-review/50407305.cms |access-date=17 April 2023 |work=[[The Times of India]]}}</ref> In the same year, the studio also released the Marathi-language romantic tragedy film ''[[Sairat]]'', directed and produced by [[Nagraj Manjule]].<ref name=fom>{{cite news |title=Fact-O-Meter: Gap Between Sairat's Collection & Other Highest Marathi Grossers Is Unimaginable! |url=https://www.koimoi.com/box-office/fact-o-meter/fact-o-meter-gap-between-sairats-collection-other-highest-marathi-grossers-is-unimaginable/ |access-date=17 April 2023 |work=Koimoi |date=21 May 2020}}</ref> It was lauded by media outlets such as ''[[The Hindu]]'', [[The Wire (India)|''The Wire'']], ''[[HuffPost]]'', ''[[The Quint]]'', and more, and highly appreciated by critics. For the first time in the history of the Marathi film industry, three songs for the film were recorded at the Sony Scoring Stage in [[Los Angeles]].<ref name="Pawar">{{Cite news |url=http://www.dnaindia.com/india/report-sairat-first-indian-film-to-record-music-at-hollywood-2194518 |title='Sairat' first Indian film to record music at Hollywood |last=Pawar |first=Yogesh |date=27 March 2016 |work=Daily News and Analysis |access-date=27 April 2016 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160502045335/http://www.dnaindia.com/india/report-sairat-first-indian-film-to-record-music-at-hollywood-2194518 |archive-date=2 May 2016}}</ref> The production included 66 instrumentalists at an expenditure of over Rs. 75 lakhs. ''Sairat''<nowiki/>'s music went on to become a sensation throughout the country after the release of the film. The film received several accolades both regionally and nationally, including 11 awards at the [[Filmfare Marathi Awards|2017 Filmfare Marathi Awards]]. It won Best Film, Best Director ([[Nagraj Manjule]]), Best Actress ([[Rinku Rajguru]]), and Best Music Album at Filmfare. Rinku Rajguru and [[Akash Thosar]] won in the best debut female and male categories, respectively. The film also premiered at the [[66th Berlin International Film Festival]], where it received a standing ovation. Rajguru received the National Film Award – Special Mention at the [[63rd National Film Awards]]. ''Sairat'' is the highest-grossing Marathi movie to date.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://dff.nic.in/writereaddata/Winners_of_63rd_NFA_2015.pdf |title=63rd National Film Awards |date=28 March 2016 |publisher=[[Directorate of Film Festivals]] |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161007194418/http://dff.nic.in/writereaddata/Winners_of_63rd_NFA_2015.pdf |archive-date=7 October 2016 |access-date=28 March 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/marathi/movies/news/Im-enjoying-this-moment-to-the-fullest-Rinku-Rajguru/articleshow/51596264.cms |title=I'm enjoying this moment to the fullest: Rinku Rajguru |last=Atulkar |first=Preeti |date=29 March 2016 |work=The Times of India |access-date=27 April 2016 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160405185223/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/marathi/movies/news/Im-enjoying-this-moment-to-the-fullest-Rinku-Rajguru/articleshow/51596264.cms |archive-date=5 April 2016}}</ref>

In the following year, Zee Studios witnessed  success with its Marathi features; ''[[Ti Saddhya Kay Karte]]'', a Marathi-language romantic drama directed by [[Satish Rajwade]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-01-07 |title=Ti Saddhya Kay Karte movie review: Marathi cinema begins 2017 with a simple pleasure |url=https://www.firstpost.com/entertainment/ti-saddhya-kay-karte-movie-review-marathi-cinema-begins-2017-with-a-simple-pleasure-3193090.html |access-date=2023-04-20 |website=Firstpost |language=en}}</ref> ''[[Chi Va Chi Sau Ka]]'', a Marathi-language comedy-drama, ran for over 100 days in many Maharashtra cities.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Lalit Prabhakar to play lead role in Chi Va Chi Sau Ka |work=The Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/marathi/chi-va-chi-sau-ka/articleshow/57922212.cms |access-date=2023-04-20 |issn=0971-8257}}</ref> ''[[Faster Fene]]'', produced by [[Riteish Deshmukh]], Genelia Deshmukh, and Mangesh Kulkarni and starring [[Girish Kulkarni]], was another Marathi language film co-produced by the company that did well in Maharashtra.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Another hit for Riteish Deshmukh |url=https://www.dnaindia.com/bollywood/report-another-hit-for-riteish-deshmukh-2556504 |access-date=2023-04-20 |website=DNA India |language=en}}</ref>

In its Hindi line-up, the studio released ''[[Mom (film)|Mom]]'', starring [[Sridevi]] in the lead role, which received rave reviews from critics.<ref>{{cite news |title=MOM China Box Office Collection: Sridevi's Film Is 100 Not Out, Joins League Of PK, Bajrangi Bhaijaan |url=https://www.ndtv.com/entertainment/mom-china-box-office-collection-sridevis-film-is-100-not-out-joins-league-of-pk-bajrangi-bhaijaan-2043738 |access-date=21 April 2023 |work=[[NDTV]]}}</ref> 

In October 2017, the company released a musical drama, ''[[Secret Superstar]]'', starring [[Aamir Khan]] and [[Zaira Wasim]], in 1,100 theatres and on 28,401 screens worldwide, with 1090 screens overseas.<ref>{{cite news |title=Secret Superstar: The highest grossing Bollywood film of 2017! |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/showbiz/grapevine/aamir-khan-secret-superstar-movie-the-highest-grossing-bollywood-film-of-2017-1529041 |access-date=21 April 2023 |work=[[The Daily Star (Bangladesh)|The Daily Star]] |date=3 February 2018 |language=en}}</ref> Soon after its release, the film went on to become one of the most profitable films of all time. The film is also the highest-grossing Indian film featuring a female protagonist, the highest-grossing Hindi film of 2017, the seventh-highest-grossing Indian film worldwide, and the second-highest-grossing Indian film overseas.<ref>{{cite news |title=Aamir Khan's Secret Superstar Beats Salman Khan's Tiger Zinda Hai to become the Biggest Worldwide Bollywood grosser of 2017 |url=https://www.bollywoodlife.com/box-office/aamir-khans-secret-superstar-beats-salman-khans-tiger-zinda-hai-to-become-the-biggest-worldwide-bollywood-grosser-of-2017-1147374/ |access-date=21 April 2023 |work=Bollywood Life |date=28 January 2018 |language=en}}</ref> Overall the film won three [[Filmfare Awards]], including Best Actress (Critics) for Zaira Wasim, Best Supporting Actress for Vij, and Best Playback Singer (Female) for [[Meghna Mishra]]. Zaira Wasim also won the National Child Award for Exceptional Achievement for her performance in the film. The company also released ''[[Qarib Qarib Singlle]]'' the same year starring [[Irrfan Khan]] and debuting in Hindi Cinema, Malayalam actress [[Parvathy Thiruvothu]], which received favorable reviews from critics.<ref>{{cite news |title=Qarib Qarib Singlle movie review: A heartfelt film where Parvathy outshines a superb Irrfan |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/movie-reviews/qarib-qarb-singlle-movie-review-irrfan-parvathy-film-will-charm-its-way-in-your-heart/story-8lR4NlcF7uV3hFANxffHVL.html |access-date=21 April 2023 |work=[[Hindustan Times]] |date=10 November 2017 |language=en}}</ref>

Meanwhile, owing to the rise of over-the-top, subscription-based media services, [[Zee Entertainment Enterprises|Zee Entertainment]] launched its video streaming service on February 14, 2018. [[ZEE5]] would use this to stream all Zee Entertainment content, from films to shows.<ref>{{cite news |title=Zee Entertainment Ltd Launches Zee5 – India's Largest Digital Entertainment Platform {{!}} India.com |url=https://www.india.com/entertainment/zee-entertainment-ltd-launches-zee5-indias-largest-digital-entertainment-platform-2894695/ |access-date=21 April 2023 |work=www.india.com |language=en}}</ref>

Zee Studios commenced the year 2018 by releasing the Marathi comedy-drama, ''[[Gulabjaam]]'', which performed averagely in the cinemas and went on to stream on ZEE5. The company also produced ''[[Beyond the Clouds (2017 film)|Beyond the Clouds]]'', which was the grown-up version of [[Majid Majidi]]'s previously directed film, ''[[Children of Heaven (1997 film)|Children of Heaven]]'' (1997).<ref>{{cite news |last1= |first1=|title='Beyond The Clouds' to premiere at BFI London Film Festival |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/beyond-the-clouds-to-premiere-at-bfi-london-film-festival-117101200264_1.html |access-date=24 April 2023 |work=[[Business Standard]] |date=12 October 2017}}</ref>

The movie was released in 2 phases; it was released overseas in 2017, premiering at the 2017 BFI London Film Festival, the [[22nd Busan International Film Festival]], the 14th Dubai International Film Festival, the 5th International Bosphorus Film Festival, the 29th Palm Springs International Film Festival, and the 48th International Film Festival of India (IFFI), while the Indian theatrical release took place on April 20, 2018.<ref>{{cite news |title=Majid Majidi Will Make Beyond The Clouds, Starring Ishaan Khattar, In 3 Languages |url=https://www.ndtv.com/entertainment/majid-majidi-will-make-beyond-the-clouds-starring-ishaan-khattar-in-3-languages-1708528 |access-date=24 April 2023 |work=[[NDTV]]}}</ref>

The studio also produced ''[[Dhadak]]'', Hindi-language remake of ''[[Sairat]]'', which became a commercial hit, introducing two actors, [[Ishaan Khatter]] and [[Janhvi Kapoor]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Ishaan, Janhvi's Dhadak collects Rs 100 cr worldwide |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/bollywood/dhadak-box-office-breaches-rs-100-crore-mark-worldwide-janhvi-kapoor-and-ishaan-khatter-film-a-hit/story-k0z8SebJuN5WqVBqijySWN.html |access-date=24 April 2023 |work=[[Hindustan Times]] |date=1 August 2018 |language=en}}</ref> Then came ''[[Paltan (film)|Paltan]]'', which received positive reviews from the families of the soldiers, but the audience and critics found the film's execution largely ineffective for a war film and an extremely long runtime.<ref>{{cite news |title=Paltan Movie Review |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/movie-reviews/paltan/movie-review/65711584.cms |access-date=24 April 2023 |work=[[The Times of India]]}}</ref> 

Two successes for Zee Studios came in the middle of the year: one from ''[[Veere Di Wedding]]'', which emerged as the fifth-highest-grossing Hindi film of the year and the highest for a film featuring female leads.<ref>{{cite news |title='Veere Di Wedding' enters 100 crore club with global box office collection |url=https://www.dnaindia.com/bollywood/report-veere-di-wedding-enters-100-crore-club-with-global-box-office-collection-2625256 |access-date=24 April 2023 |work=DNA India |language=en}}</ref> The other was ''[[Raazi]]'', which became the second commercially successful film with a female lead to join the  ₹ 100 crore club in India.<ref>{{cite news |title=Raazi box office collection: Alia Bhatt film collects Rs 123.17 crore in the domestic market |url=https://www.zeebiz.com/india/news-raazi-box-office-collection-alia-bhatt-film-collects-rs-12317-crore-in-the-domestic-market-52649 |access-date=24 April 2023 |work=[[Zee Business]] |date=26 June 2018}}</ref> At the [[64th Filmfare Awards]], Raazi received 15 nominations and won 5 awards, including Best Film, Best Director ([[Meghna Gulzar]]), and Best Actress ([[Alia Bhatt]]).

''[[Mulk (film)|Mulk]]'', a legal drama released later that year, received positive reviews and won a Filmfare Award in the category of ‘Best Story’.<ref>{{cite news |title=Winners of the 64th Vimal Elaichi Filmfare Awards 2019 |url=https://www.filmfare.com/news/bollywood/all-winners-of-the-64th-vimal-filmfare-awards-2019_-33004-10.html |access-date=24 April 2023 |work=[[Filmfare Awards|Filmfare]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Complete list of winners at the 64th Filmfare Awards |url=https://www.pratidintime.com/entertainment/complete-list-of-winners-at-the-64th-filmfare-awards |access-date=24 April 2023 |work=[[Pratidin Time]] |language=en}}</ref> Zee Studios also distributed ''[[Gold (2018 film)|Gold]]'', a period sports film starring [[Akshay Kumar]], with a budget of ₹ 61 crores, which ended up crossing the ₹ 100 crore mark at the box office.<ref>{{cite news |title=Akshay Kumar's Gold crosses Rs 100 crore mark at BO, slower than usual |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/bollywood/akshay-kumar-s-gold-crosses-rs-100-crore-mark-at-box-office-but-so-have-7-other-films-in-2018/story-4Bpg96e7YEb3jJh4mPhHAI.html |access-date=24 April 2023 |work=[[Hindustan Times]] |date=28 August 2018 |language=en}}</ref>

Zee Studios produced a wide range of films in 2019 ''[[Manikarnika: The Queen of Jhansi]]'' performed well both nationally and internationally and became one of the highest-grossing women-centric films in India.<ref>{{cite news |title=Manikarnika: The Queen Of Jhansi Movie Review : Patriotic and entertaining war drama, fuelled by Kangana Ranaut's performance |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/movie-reviews/manikarnika-the-queen-of-jhansi/movie-review/67674985.cms |access-date=24 April 2023 |work=[[The Times of India]]}}</ref> [[Kangana Ranaut]]'s portrayal of [[Rani of Jhansi|Rani Lakshmi Bai]] in the film garnered critical acclaim, winning her the National Film Award for Best Actress at the [[67th National Film Awards]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Kangana Ranaut decks up to receive her 4th National Award. See pics |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/bollywood/kangana-ranaut-decks-up-to-receive-her-4th-national-award-all-set-to-receive-the-highest-honour-for-an-artist-101635140653647.html |access-date=24 April 2023 |work=[[Hindustan Times]] |date=25 October 2021 |language=en}}</ref> The film was selected for the Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival and was screened at the Kashi Indian International Film Festival, Itanagar International Film Festival, and at the Indian Embassy in Lebanon under the [[Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav]] event.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Mohan |first1=Man |title=On My Radar: Kangana Ranaut @ Rani Ki Jhansi in Lebanon |url=https://sundayguardianlive.com/news/radar-kangana-ranaut-rani-ki-jhansi-lebanon |access-date=24 April 2023 |work=[[The Sunday Guardian]] |date=25 December 2021}}</ref>

The company also produced the romantic comedy-drama, ''[[Kala Shah Kala]]'' in Punjabi.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Singh |first1=Mohnish |title=Nawazuddin Siddiqui lined-up for the remake of Punjabi film Kala Shah Kala |url=https://www.bollywoodmdb.com/bollywood-news-adda/nawazuddin-siddiqui-lined-up-for-the-remake-of-punjabi-film-kala-shah-kala |access-date=1 May 2023 |work=BollywoodMDB |date=29 December 2021 |language=en}}</ref> It was well-received and rapidly rose to commercial success. It currently ranks as the 21st-highest-earning Punjabi movie. ''[[Kesari (2019 film)|Kesari]]'' was another hit film produced and distributed internationally by the company.<ref>{{cite news |title=Kesari box office collection day 1: HUGE! Akshay Kumar starrer earns big, set for Rs 200 cr club? |url=https://www.zeebiz.com/india/news-kesari-box-office-collection-day-1-huge-akshay-kumar-starrer-earns-big-set-for-rs-200-cr-club-91091 |access-date=1 May 2023 |work=[[Zee Business]] |date=22 March 2019}}</ref> 

Throughout the year, the studio produced films like  ''[[Rampaat]]'',<ref>{{cite news |title='Rampaat' teaser: Ravi Jadhav gives us a fun-filled ride through the movie with a foot-tapping rap in the background |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/marathi/movies/news/rampaat-teaser-ravi-jadhav-gives-us-a-fun-filled-ride-through-the-movie-with-a-foot-tapping-rap-in-the-background/articleshow/68251965.cms |access-date=1 May 2023 |work=[[The Times of India]]}}</ref> ''[[Pailwaan]]'' (Hindi dubbed), and ''[[Nerkonda Paarvai]]'',<ref>{{cite news |title=Nerkonda Paarvai Box Office Collection Worldwide: Rs 100 crore Blockbuster! Thala Ajith film shatters records! |url=https://www.zeebiz.com/india/news-nerkonda-paarvai-box-office-collection-worldwide-rs-100-crore-blockbuster-thala-ajith-film-shatters-records-108587 |access-date=1 May 2023 |work=Zee Business |date=18 August 2019}}</ref> which performed commercially well. They also produced a film named, ''[[The Tashkent Files]]'', a thriller about the death of former Indian Prime Minister [[Lal Bahadur Shastri]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Zee Studios' The Tashkent Files emerges as a winner at the Box Office |url=https://zeenews.india.com/bollywood/zee-studios-the-tashkent-files-emerges-as-a-winner-at-the-box-office-2205002.html |access-date=1 May 2023 |work=[[Zee News]] |language=en}}</ref> 

Another well-received film was [[Anubhav Sinha]]'s directorial, [[Article 15 (film)|Article 15]],  which was the opening film for the 10th edition of the London Indian Film Festival and has won 3 [[65th Filmfare Awards|Filmfare Awards]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Article 15 Awards: List of Awards won by Hindi movie Article 15 |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/movie-details/article-15/movieawards/68281716.cms |access-date=1 May 2023 |work=The Times of India}}</ref>- Best Film Critic (Anubhav Sinha), Best Actor Critic ([[Ayushmann Khurrana]]) and Best Story (Anubhav Sinha and Gaurav Solanki).<ref>{{cite news |title=Article 15 - Movie - Box Office India |url=https://www.boxofficeindia.com/movie.php?movieid=5678 |access-date=1 May 2023 |work=www.boxofficeindia.com}}</ref> At the end of the year, the studio came out with the lighthearted comedy-drama ''[[Good Newwz]]'' which became the 5th highest-grossing Bollywood film of 2019.<ref>{{cite news |title=Good Newwz grosses Rs. 300 cr. worldwide; becomes the 5th highest worldwide grosser of 2019 |url=https://www.bollywoodhungama.com/news/box-office-special-features/good-newwz-grosses-rs-300-cr-worldwide-becomes-5th-highest-worldwide-grosser-2019/ |access-date=1 May 2023 |date=18 January 2020 |language=en}}</ref>
